The Big Story · Work & Economy

Japan raised this wage by ¥59. What must ¥1,090 buy?

Akita’s minimum wage rose 5.7% today, from ¥1,031 to ¥1,090 an hour. The floor is progress—and a window into Japan’s regional wage divide.

Japanese word of the day最低賃金 · saitei chingin

“Minimum wage.” 最低 means lowest; 賃金 means wages. Japan’s phrase usually comes with a prefecture because each region sets its own floor.
